proposed_widenings.name: shared charge-backed magic-item spell menu with per-spell cast timing
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation family has one item-level activationCost, but this item exposes one shared charge pool across a menu that includes a reaction spell and longer-cast spells. The shared resource shape exists; the per-spell timing shape does not.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You can press one of those faces, expend the number of charges required for it, and thereby cast the spell associated with it (save DC 17), as shown in the Cube of Force Faces table."

notes: Did not author content/magic_item_cube_of_force.dhall. The item mostly matches existing charge-cast item support, and dcOverride would cover the fixed save DC 17, but the current surface cannot represent one shared charge pool across spell grants with heterogeneous casting times honestly.
